<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents an answer in the system, providing a structured way to handle question and alternative IDs.

Description: This class is used to model an answer in the system, ensuring that the question and alternative IDs are properly validated and stored. It is instantiated whenever an answer needs to be represented or processed, typically by services that handle user interactions or data storage.

Attributes:
    question_id (int): The ID of the question to which this answer belongs. This is set during initialization and remains immutable.
    alternative_id (int): The ID of the alternative associated with this answer. This is also set during initialization and remains constant throughout the object's lifecycle.
</DOCSTRING>
